program.name: Work & Rest
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: A steady full-body circuit, then a Tabata: work, rest, work, rest, until you are done.
program.about: Two kinds of conditioning in one session. First a steady full-body circuit with a short rest between rounds, then a Tabata, twenty seconds as hard as you can and ten seconds of rest, eight times. The circuit builds the base and the Tabata pushes the ceiling. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps.
